name: Snatchmon
main_effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Vemmon] in its text among them to the hand. trash the rest. Then, you may place up to 2 [Vemmon] from your trash as 1 of your Digimon's bottom digivolution cards.
source_effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any [Vemmon] are returned to the bottom of the deck from this Digimon's digivolution cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 4 or less.
